episodes.synopsis: Bullied outcast Rudo finds respite in repurposing trash, until a terrible tragedy changes his life forever.
episodes.title: The Sphere

episodes.synopsis: Cast into the Pit, Rudo is saved by the mysterious Enjin who may not have his best interests at heart.
episodes.title: The Inhabited

episodes.synopsis: Enjin is a Giver, a being who can give life to things and draw out their power. Ludo, who has also awakened to his power as a Giver, is scouted by Enjin to join an organization called the Cleaners, which fights against the Spotted Beasts born from garbage. Ludo accepts the offer in order to find a way to return to the Heavenly World where he has lived until now, but he suddenly gets into a fight with his trainer, Zanca.
episodes.title: The Ground

episodes.synopsis: After being introduced to Cleaner HQ, Rudo follows Riyo on a job to learn the business.
episodes.title: Cleaner HQ

episodes.synopsis: The Cleaners go on a job to save another Sphereite who survived the fall. Rudo tags along to learn more.
episodes.title: Raiders

episodes.synopsis: With the job having gone terribly wrong, Rudo finds himself face to face with a merciless Raider named Jabber.
episodes.title: One Good Strike!!

episodes.synopsis: Jabber employs a new strategy to get through Rudo's defenses, and another ally joins the fray.
episodes.title: A Score to Settle

episodes.synopsis: Rudo deals with the emotional aftermath of the Jabber fight and gets a new lead about returning to the Sphere.
episodes.title: Moving Forward

episodes.synopsis: To get a "spell" for their next mission, the Cleaners head to Canvas Town, where they make a tragic discovery.
episodes.title: The City of Graffiti

episodes.synopsis: With their gear-up complete, the crew heads into the No Man's Land, Penta, to get clues about the Sphere.
episodes.title: Penta: The Desert No Man's Land

episodes.synopsis: A mysterious woman living in the No Man's Land challenges the crew from an unexpected angle.
episodes.title: Amo's Hospitality

episodes.synopsis: Tamsy and Zanka fight to save their captive allies. In the aftermath, Rudo has an unexpected reaction.
episodes.title: Something Like a Curse

episodes.synopsis: Amo tells the story of how she came to the tower and of the "angels" who came to visit her.
episodes.title: An Empty Gaze

episodes.synopsis: After returning from the Penta No Man's Land, Rudo and the Cleaners face a series of new threats.
episodes.title: The Storm Before the Storm

episodes.synopsis: Taken by the Raiders to an unknown setting, the Cleaners fight for their lives, and Zodyl makes Rudo an offer.
episodes.title: Clash!

episodes.synopsis: Bundus interrogates the Santas while Zanka struggles to keep pace with a powered-up Jabber.
episodes.title: Gifted and Not

episodes.synopsis: Zanka reflects on the turning point in his past that brought him to where he is today.
episodes.title: Memories of a Mediocrity

episodes.synopsis: While the Raiders-Cleaners conflicts continue, the battle between Riyo and Noerde heats up.
episodes.title: Oh Zap, Totes Legit

episodes.synopsis: Zodyl reveals his plan to reach the Sphere, and the other Cleaners react to their current circumstances.
episodes.title: Watchmen Series

episodes.synopsis: As the battle climaxes, Enjin makes a play to unite his team, and Zodyl makes his final entreaty to Rudo.
episodes.title: Ensign

episodes.synopsis: Exiled from his home, Rudo seeks vengeance on those responsible. But first, he must survive a wasteland.
episodes.title: Race Against Time

episodes.synopsis: Noerde is doing everything he can to prevent the cleaning crew from escaping before they cross the border on the haphazard contraption.
episodes.title: The Power of Protection

episodes.synopsis: As the Cleaners take stock after the battle, a convalescing Zanka receives some surprising news.
episodes.title: The Man Who Will Be Stronger

episodes.synopsis: Rudo and the other child Cleaners take a trip to Canvas Town while Corvus entertains some unwanted guests.
episodes.title: Field Trip
